_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Dan wasa Snake a kan {width}×{height} grid.
Kuna sarrafa maciji {player_id}. Motsawa masu inganci: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (ko w/s/a/d).
Buri: tsira mafi tsawo ko kuwa mafi tsawo kuma samu maki mafi girma (iyakar motsawa {max_turns} motsawa).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} dǝ dalil letǝgǝna ba ro gәrza.

outcome.survived_win: Kambiwu {player_id} dә kənəngatǝna; sandi gade samma so gǝrza.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Njokawa samma so dǝ sa fal lan kәrmuzayin.
outcome.turn_limit: Kәnza kalkalye dәga sǝdǝna - nǝmkambe kambowo dǝ tie-break lan kǝnasarjin.
